description: Hi! I am participating as an online solo developer under the Hyderabad track. I am using this space to build my project using open NASA data and hosting my code on GitHub. Looking forward to a great hackathon weekend!
summary:
AstroCare is a web-based prototype designed to support astronaut health monitoring during space missions. Astronauts face unique health challenges in space, making continuous awareness of vital health indicators important. AstroCare provides an interactive dashboard to monitor health parameters such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, and body temperature, along with health trends and alerts.

The prototype allows users to explore simulated health readings, observe changes in vital signs, and understand how abnormal readings can be highlighted for attention. It aims to make health information accessible through a simple and user-friendly interface.

AstroCare addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by exploring how digital health monitoring tools can assist astronauts during missions where immediate medical support from Earth may be limited. This project is an educational prototype and does not replace professional medical evaluation.
details:
AstroCare is an interactive web-based astronaut health monitoring prototype developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

The project focuses on supporting astronaut health awareness during space missions through a simple and accessible dashboard. It displays health indicators such as heart rate, oxygen saturation, and body temperature. The dashboard includes health trends and alerts to help users identify readings that may require attention.

The prototype uses simulated health data to demonstrate how a digital monitoring system could work. Users can explore health readings, observe changes, and interact with the dashboard. The system is designed to present health information in a clear and understandable format.

AstroCare aims to contribute to astronaut health awareness and support the concept of timely health monitoring during missions where communication with Earth may be delayed.

The project was developed as a web application using web development technologies. It is publicly deployed through GitHub Pages for easy access and demonstration.

AstroCare is an educational prototype. It does not provide medical diagnosis or replace professional medical advice.

The project's main goal is to demonstrate a creative, accessible, and user-friendly approach to astronaut health monitoring.
